items.title: Training human super-recognizers' detection and discrimination of AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_empirical: In two different experimental designs, we found that SRs (total N = 283) were better at detecting and discriminating synthetic faces than controls (total N = 381), where control participants were below chance without training.
judge.evidence_topic: Here, we investigate synthetic face detection and discrimination in super-recognizers (SRs; who have exceptional face recognition skills), and typical-ability control participants.
judge.reason: O artigo trata da detecção de rostos sintéticos gerados por IA, conforme exigido pelo pedido. Realiza estudo empírico com participantes humanos em dois experimentos. O método e o tamanho da amostra extraídos conferem com o resumo. O achado principal está claramente sustentado no resumo.

items.title: Voice clones sound realistic but not (yet) hyperrealistic

judge.evidence_empirical: We investigated the extent to which AI-generated voices sound real to human listeners, and whether listeners can accurately distinguish between human and AI-generated voices.
judge.evidence_topic: We investigated the extent to which AI-generated voices sound real to human listeners, and whether listeners can accurately distinguish between human and AI-generated voices.
judge.reason: O achado é integralmente sustentado pelo resumo: 'We find that voice clones can sound as real as human voices, making it difficult for listeners to distinguish between them. However, we did not observe a hyperrealism effect.'

items.title: Training humans for synthetic face image detection

items.title: AI-generated images of familiar faces are indistinguishable from real photographs

judge.evidence_empirical: Our results demonstrated that generated images of both fictional (Experiment 1) and celebrity identities (Experiment 2) could not be distinguished from real photographs.
judge.evidence_topic: latest ‘off the shelf’ AI tools can now generate face images of real people that are essentially undetectable as synthetic to most human observers.
judge.reason: O artigo relata uma investigação sobre a capacidade de observadores humanos distinguirem imagens faciais geradas por IA de fotografias reais, com quatro experimentos, alinhandose ao tema de percepção de credibilidade de imagens sintéticas. O resumo confirma a coleta de dados pròprios com participantes humanos, o mètodo descrito nos dados extraídos (julgamento de imagens de ChatGPT/DALL·E) é consistente com o resumo, e o achado extraído de que rostos familiares gerados por IA sã indistinguíveis està diretamente amparado pelo resumo.

items.title: Real and Deepfake Face Recognition: An EEG Study on Cognitive and Emotive Implications

judge.evidence_empirical: EEG data were collected from 23 healthy participants using a 21-channel dry-EEG headset; power spectrum and event-related potential (ERP) analyses were performed.
judge.evidence_topic: This study investigated healthy individuals' cognitive and emotional engagement in a visual discrimination task involving real and deepfake human faces expressing positive, negative, or neutral emotions.
judge.reason: O artigo é sobre discriminação humana entre rostos reais e deepfakes, usando EEG, atendendo ao tema e às restrições de estudo empírico. O método extraído corresponde ao resumo, e o achado está respaldado pelos resultados do EEG descritos.

items.title: People are poorly equipped to detect AI-powered voice clones

judge.evidence_empirical: Through a series of perceptual studies, we report on the realism of AI-generated voices...
judge.evidence_topic: We find human participants cannot consistently identify recordings of AI-generated voices.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo perceptual com participantes humanos sobre detecção de vozes geradas por IA, totalmente dentro do pedido. O método extraído corresponde ao resumo, e o achado está totalmente sustentado pelos resultados descritos (identificação inconsistente, alta correspondência de identidade).

items.title: Deepfake smiles matter less—the psychological and neural impact of presumed AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_empirical: Using EEG, we tracked participants’ (N = 30) brain responses to real faces showing positive, neutral, and negative expressions, after being informed that they are either real or fake.
judge.evidence_topic: Here we investigate the impact of the belief that depicted persons are real or deepfakes on psychological and neural measures of human face perception.
judge.reason: O artigo investiga experimentalmente como a crença de que rostos são deepfakes afeta a percepção, com EEG e avaliações. Está no recorte de estudos empíricos sobre credibilidade de conteúdo sintético, sem foco político. O método descrito nos dados extraídos (EEG + avaliações de expressões rotuladas como reais ou falsas) coincide com o resumo. O achado de que sorrisos rotulados falsos são percebidos como menos positivos e geram respostas neurais atenuadas é sustentado pelo resumo, que afirma que smiles marcados como falsos parecem menos positivos e não evocam os efeitos neurais típicos.

items.title: AI Hyperrealism: Why AI Faces Are Perceived as More Real Than Human Ones

judge.evidence_empirical: In Experiment 1 ( N = 124 adults), alongside our reanalysis of previously published data, we showed that White AI faces are judged as human more often than actual human faces... judge.evidence_topic: AI-generated faces are now indistinguishable from human faces... White AI faces are judged as human more often than actual human faces
judge.reason: O artigo investiga como pessoas percebem rostos gerados por IA (deepfakes), está dentro do escopo; é estudo empírico com dois experimentos e participantes humanos; o método extraído condiz com o resumo; o achado principal reflete fielmente o resumo.

items.title: AI-synthesized faces are indistinguishable from real faces and more trustworthy

judge.evidence_empirical: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable—and more trustworthy—than real faces.
judge.evidence_topic: Artificial intelligence (AI)-synthesized text, audio, image, and video are being weaponized for the purposes of nonconsensual intimate imagery, financial fraud, and disinformation campaigns. Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable—and more trustworthy—than real faces.
judge.reason: O artigo trata de rostos sintéticos e da percepção de fotorealismo e confiabilidade, o que se alinha ao tema de credibilidade de imagens sintéticas. No entando, o resumo não menciona participantes humanos, experimentos, ou qualquer méto do empírico com coleta de dados humanos. Portanto, não atende ao critério de estudo empírico com participantes humanos exigido pelo pedido. Os dados extraidos afirmam um estudo experimental, mas isso não é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: What you see is not what you get anymore: a mixed-methods approach on human perception of AI-generated images

judge.evidence_empirical: A total of 104 participants took part in an online survey, classifying 50 images (25 real, 25 AI-generated) from five leading TTI models.
judge.evidence_topic: This study explores human perception and detection capabilities regarding AI-generated images
judge.reason: O resumo relata que participantes identificaram corretamente imagens geradas por IA em 63,7% dos casos, e em apenas 29% com o modelo FLUX.1-dev, o que sustenta o achado de desempenho pior para modelos mais recentes.

items.title: Deepfake detection with and without content warnings

judge.reason: O resumo afirma exatamente que 'only 21.6% of respondents correctly identify the deepfake as the only inauthentic video', confirmando integralmente o achado principal.

items.title: On the realness of people who do not exist: The social processing of artificial faces

judge.evidence_empirical: "GAN faces were more likely to be perceived as real than REAL faces, a pattern partly explained by intrinsic stimulus characteristics. Moreover, participants' realness judgments influenced their behavior because they displayed increased social conformity toward faces perceived as real, independently of their actual realness."
judge.evidence_topic: "Here, we focus on how people evaluate realistic-looking faces of non-existing people generated by generative adversarial networks (GANs)."
judge.reason: O artigo se encaixa perfeitamente no pedido. O tópico é sobre avaliação de rostos sintéticos (GAN), com estudos empíricos com participantes humanos. items.title: Interpretation of AI-Generated vs. Human-Made Images
